'''Bears''' were a variety of stocky, omnivorous mammals found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They tended to have a mainly carnivorous diet.

{{Creature-stub}}

==Known species==
*[[Sand bear]] of [[Kallistas]]
*[[D'oemir bear]] of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]
*[[Renda bear]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]
*[[Snow Bear]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]
*[[Garu-bear/Legends|Garu-bear]]

==Uses of bear in names==
*[[Bear (Jedi)|Bear]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]
*[[Bear (K-wing pilot)|Bear]], a [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]
*[[Bear Clan]], a group of [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]
*[[Bear spider]], a species of [[Spider/Legends|spider]]

==Ambiguous bears==
*[[Bursa/Legends|Bursa]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] greatly resembled bears.
*[[Balinaka]] of [[Garnib]] were a sentient race called "bears" by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] personnel.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' {{C|page 17}}</ref>
*Some individuals thought [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were "little bears." [[Mace Towani]] once used this phrase to describe them.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
*The [[Botori]] of the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]] were a sentient ursine species.

==Behind the scenes==
Along with the sounds of various other animals, real-life bear sounds were mixed to create [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] dialogue in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and subsequent films and media for himself and other [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].
